rules.when: open-ended reasoning and judgment: planning, specifying, architecture and design decisions, investigating and diagnosing unclear problems, auditing, independent final review, deciding what is true or what to build, orchestrating role pipelines, and all wiki-tool work. Effort follows the task: low for clear questions; medium for anything ambiguous, multi-step, or design-heavy
frontend and visual work where taste and pixel precision decide the outcome: UI, layout, styling, motion and design systems (not the Harbor Supply website or Tide Arena, which rule 7 owns)

work whose hard requirement is a capability only the Codex/GPT lane provides: OpenAI image generation or editing, video generation, live web or realtime news context, or a brief that must invoke a mattpocock-skills plugin skill (grill-intake, wayfinder, to-spec, to-tickets and similar)

token-eating bulk work that needs volume more than judgment: rote renames, formatting sweeps, typo fixes, rerunning tests, applying an already-settled patch, mass file gathering, documentation or source sweeps, wiki restructuring and page writing to a settled standard, transcript distillation, and repetitive inventories or comparisons

beats.when: the work is pure volume with no judgment or design in it

rules.when: work that needs no thinking or has to be done as fast as possible: fast research and quick lookups (product and price searches, first-pass web or GitHub research, fact checks), status or inventory reads, small mechanical edits with an obvious result, simple one-step fixes, short drafts, and any small task where speed matters more than judgment

beats.when: the task has no open question and only needs to be done quickly
the change is small and mechanical, and speed matters more than careful implementation

rules.when: well-scoped implementation with a clear target: building a specified feature, fixing a bug whose cause is known or easy to find, refactoring, writing or fixing tests, documentation changes, and routine reviews of a bounded change

beats.when: the task is already specified or its fix is clear, with no open design question

rules.when: any work on the Harbor Supply website (harbor-site) or the Tide Arena game (tide-arena), whatever its kind except pure image generation
